# Beating AI defeatism

Maxime Jérôme Rolland-Calligaro

November 11, 2026

Ahead of the informal European leaders’ summit on AI this Friday, Renew Europe MEPs visited JUPITER, one of Europe’s most powerful supercomputers, in Forschungszentrum Jülich in Germany. The visit comes as the EU’s call for AI gigafactories is open, with the first bids due by the end of the year.

The message Renew Europe MEPs heard from researchers at the site was simple: don’t give up the AI race! [...] >
